Basically you have to create a .vmdk of your block device and add that as storage in the GUI:

VBoxManage internalcommands createrawvmdk -filename windisk.vmdk -rawdisk /dev/disk/by-id/X
usermod -a -G disk user

Where X is your harddrive and "user" is your username, you don't want to specify a storage device like /dev/sda because that can change across reboots and you'll end up booting the OS you're running on one day. The usermod line is for enabling raw disk access for the user.
